title: Probability and statistics
summary: Probability, Venn diagrams, two-way tables, set notation, arrays, tree diagrams, relative frequency, sampling, averages, stem-and-leaf plots, spread and box plots.

fig.alt: Venn diagram: 8 in A only, 5 in both, 7 in B only, 10 in neither

cards.title: Set notation
cards.rule: \(A \cap B\): A and B. \(A \cup B\): A or B (or both). \(A'\): not A.

cards.title: Arrays for two-step experiments
cards.rule: List every pair of outcomes in a table.

cards.title: Tree diagrams
cards.rule: Multiply along the branches. Add the results you want.
lines: 3 red and 2 blue, take 2 without replacement: \(P(\text{both red}) = \tfrac35 \times \tfrac24 = \tfrac{3}{10}\)
cards.tip: without replacement, the second branch has one fewer.

cards.title: Relative frequency
cards.rule: Relative frequency \(= \dfrac{\text{times it happened}}{\text{number of trials}}\)
lines: A pin lands point-up 36 times in 120 throws: \(\tfrac{36}{120} = 0.3\)
cards.note: More trials give a better estimate.

cards.title: Data and sampling
cards.rule: A sample should represent the whole population. Random samples avoid bias.
lines: Categorical: colours, types. Numerical: discrete (counts) or continuous (measurements)
Asking only gym members how often people exercise is biased

cards.title: Mean, median and mode
cards.rule: Mean: add and divide. Median: middle value in order. Mode: most common.

cards.title: Stem-and-leaf plots
cards.rule: The stem is the tens, the leaf is the units. Leaves go in order.

cards.title: Grouping data into classes
cards.rule: Group numerical data into equal class intervals, then draw a histogram.
lines: Classes 0–9, 10–19, 20–29 with a frequency for each
cards.note: With grouped data, use the class centres to estimate the mean.

cards.title: Range and interquartile range
cards.rule: Range = max − min. IQR \(= Q_3 - Q_1\), the spread of the middle half.

cards.title: Box plots
cards.rule: Draw the five-number summary: min, Q₁, median, Q₃, max. The box holds the middle 50%.

fig.alt: Box plot: min 2, Q1 4.5, median 7.5, Q3 11, max 15
